== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Alexander Glasco. Prescott deed C114 names Alexander Glasco of Rochester, express agent, as the son of James, the Prescott carpenter.<ref>Inspected historical source; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSLG-LQRC-Y record].</ref> Original deed inspected. This is a separate Alexander; it does not identify [[Alexander-951]]. The identification remains uncertain.
